101206.name: Deathmatch
101206.describe: Consumes all AP. Duels a target with 2 Melee Weapons, dealing <color=#F74848>0.65x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. The duel lasts for <color=#F74848>4</color> rounds or until Camilla can no longer attack or the target cannot retaliate. This skirmish will not be affected by external factors such as <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf>, <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, or <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>.
